resources.string:
1. Check the match number and the position assigned to you on the scouting schedule. 
 	 2. Enter your name, the robot number, robot position, and the human player position. 
 	 3. Start in the Auto section. 
 	 4. Watch your assigned robot, filling out the fields associated with your robot's actions. 
 	 5. When the first bell rings, go to the Tele-Op section. 
 	 6. Repeat step 4. 
 	 7. When the game is over, go to the Endgame section and fill out the boxes. 
 	 8. Go to the Notes section, and input any notes. 
 	 9. Click the 3 lines on the right, and select submit.

\t \u2022 Some helpful piece of text related to the game. \n \t \u2022 You can find the human player position by looking at the players\' shirt colors, and inferring their team. \n \t \u2022 Examples of things to put in the notes box: If the robot is a skateboard, a defense bot, or their auto fails.

\t \u2022 TERM = The definition of something that is useful to a scouter. \n \t \u2022 COOPERITION BONUS = If both alliance\'s work together to do something. \n \t \u2022 RANKING POINT = The criteria for a specific ranking point.
\t \u2022 A specific yet common penalty and how it\'s caused. \n \t \u2022 If there is a penalty, the ref closest to the offender will wave a flag that corresponds to their team\'s color.

\t \u2022 A visual cue that could be helpful to the scouter. \n \t \u2022 Once a team receives a YELLOW or RED CARD, a yellow rectangle will show next to the team number on the audience display. \n \t \u2022 If COOPERTITION is enabled, a handshake icon will be on the scoreboard.
